I really LOVE this game. So far Its my favourite dungeon crawler beside Monsters Den. The story is quite weak, the ending abrupt, but the game is very strategical, the variety of classes increases the replayablity - Ive needed around 100 hours for my first playthrough -, and I like the way the classes, their skills and skill trees are designed like in the older World of Warcraft games. Its actually a mini world of warcraft singeplayer game. High amount of action, not as many riddles - what I find much better. The dungeoncreater feature is nice to have, but quite coomplicated and too time-consuming.

I wished there was a kind of infinite dungeon mode, like in monsters den, where you can grind through dungeons as long as you want, since, as I said, making your own dungeons takes just too much time for it, and there are no downloadable custom dungeons from another players that I could have found. The player could also enjoy the max level character longer this way. This would be a great content for a buyable DLC, and I really hope that a 2nd game will be released some day, since I had a LOT of fun with this game. Weak story, strong gameplay with tank, dps and healer roles.

P.s. for any new players: i'd recommend to download some mods from the workshop right in the beginning, like the rewamp of the necromancer, they make the game much better. Unfortunately I found this mod just when I had finished the game with my necromancer.

Whether you enjoy Fall of the Dungeon Guardians is going to come down to how much you like the games combat system. The best thing you can do is watch a video of the combat in action because theres alot of it and this dungeons a beast at a whopping 20 levels, so if you don't like it, it will drag and badly. Lucky for you theres quite a few options to play with to get it into the sweet spot that suits you. 

But lets talk about the basics first before we get into tweaking these things. You'll be playing a very specific party setup, I went with the default party, character creation is basically non-existent, you'll answer a few questions and get assigned a filler party for whatever roles you didn't pick. Go with it, the game requires specific party roles and if you dont bring a healer or a tank or whatever you've failed before the game even starts; the fact that theres no character creation also means you can't see your skills or stats until after you've started, you get a free respec at the start (and every few levels) because you can't even choose your subclass to start. So stick to a basic party, you'll get quite a few repecs so it you will have a chance to experiment (I saved my game and reloaded after trying out a few builds so even then you;ll be safe from losing all your respec points).

Now the combat itself is real time with pause, you'll cycle through your skills, managing agrro on your front row while casters and healers in the back do their thing, at first you wont have enough skills to cycle but you obviously get more as you level. But heres the problem alot of these skill dont feel impactful, now I don't mean that they don't do anything, you need to use them in the right place to win a fight, what I mean is theres not alot of strategy going into most fights, once you have your basic rotation up and running that'll do for all your basic combat encounters which are the majority of encounters. Thats a problem as for most encounters theres nothing to really differentiate an encounter with a goblin from a wyvern or a barbarian. I had an interrupt on my fighter but only boss fights take advantage of this mechanic, enemies have mana but their casters can't for example be mana drained or silenced, a warriors skill might hit one target or use one that hits two targets, you use the same cycle of buffs at the start of each combat the only time you really need to change things up is if a boss resists the only damage type your character does and then you just repec until you need to change damage again. For the majority of the game its just going through the same cycle of abilities each combat again and again. 

And theres alot of combat, the game has an option thats on by default that halves the amount of monsters in the game and I get why, because it drags hard. On the highest difficulty the combat requires you to constantly pause and the game gets tedious fast. Thankfully bosses mix things up abit and its a shame there isn't more combat on that level. Lucky for us the saving grace here is that you can change the difficulty at anytime and the custom difficulty sliders saved this for me. I did need time to experiment and hit that sweet spot and your mileage may vary, but I was able to lower the monster damage so I didn't need to pause the game and it took abit longer but I was able to get the monster HP down enough to stop fights from dragging out forever while still being high enough to need to use all my abilites in a fight and on top of that you can adjust Elite and boss monsters separately to keep those guys tougher so they still feel special.

And thats important because because the combat is the main draw here, there are other things here to recommend this game, the dungeon itself (after the starting levels) looks good, it has multiple elevation levels and some complex layouts that make exploring fun. Less fun (or more depending on your tastes) is that puzzles are isolated to side areas on each floor, rather than breaking up combat like in other crawlers. It isn't helped that itemisation is randomised and restricted to just stat increases as quite often after taking time to solve a puzzle you get an item thats a downgrade, even if its not minor upgrades just aren't very satisfying to find and this hurts exploration (the first legendary rank item I found was a direct downgrade, the second a very minor buff replaced one level later by a random drop), and you'll have to scour each level looking for healing items and potions that you will need (unless you turn difficulty right down, but don't do that without combat theres just too much empty space) but at least the game makes you use them (I'm a hoarder and would usually end the game full up on potions, not here). There is an extended puzzle quest covering the whole game but it if you ever miss a clue you'll need to backtrack to find it, if you can be bothered. 

This thing is a mixed bag check out the combat first before playing but understand that you'll be engaging with that core system if it looks like it takes way to long, you can fix that, if you don't want to pause you can fix that, if you WANT a grind you can fix that, hell you can set it so everything is a one shot if you really want, and being flexible like that is a good reason to check this one out if you already like the genre.

Really solid dungeon crawler. Smooth UI, complex dungeons, a large cast of monsters, clever puzzles all set this game a step above most of its peers, but what's really unique is the combat system.

Basically, we've done away with roaming creatures or random encounters for a more turn based rotational system that's aided with an ingame pause. As you kill creatures and level up you gain talent points that can further bolster your characters with new abilities. If you've played WoW you'll recognise the trees, as they're heavily inspired from them. That's not a bad thing, because the talent trees in WoW were really well done. It's something you'll either love or hate, but you can set the combat to be insignificant so you can focus on the exploration instead if you like.

As for exploration, every floor gets two maps, the first which is relatively easy to find, shows where you've been, and the second uncovers the entire map, allowing you to hunt down those missing secrets. I'd have liked the uncovering map to have been a default -- it possibly is in the options, but I like to punish myself -- but it's a nice touch. Most levels can be navigated with memory, bar a couple full of teleporters which just gave me a headache. But again, it goes to show the amount of love that's gone into crafting unique settings and areas when so many would just draw lines around a 30 x 30 square and call it a day.

My only niggle is the sheer amount of loot -- literally every monster drops something. Again, this will either be a plus or a minus depending on your tastes, but I often found that it slowed the game down drastically having to double check after every battle whether the item dropped was an upgrade, sidegrade, or trash. But that's a really small complaint on a game I've dumped almost 50 hours into going on the hardest difficulty first.

A fun take on old school dungeon crawlers, with a strong emphasis on combat. The combat is more akin to something like an MMORPG than to other takes on the genre, centered around resource management (in the form of mana and cooldowns, including a global cooldown!) and randomly generated loot, with less of an emphasis on dodging monster attacks (only some attacks, mostly projectiles, can be avoided through movement). On the higher difficulties, this all adds up to a very pleasing puzzle of the "do I use one of my strictly finite healing potions now, or save it for later" variety. The game also has a great variety of options to customize your play experience, right down to an option to decrease the number of combat encounters in the game, while rebalancing the amount of experience to be roughly the same!

Overall, I highly recommend.

In fact, I'm not even sure it was 'doing it' for the devs when they were making it. It's telling that the default checkboxed difficulty setting is one which "halves" the enemy encounters throughout the game. It's as though even the people making the game realized how weak and unengaging the combat system was and tried their very best to spare you most of it.

The difficulty settings are many and varied, which is appreciated. I could crank it all the way down to the easiest modes, in which I would mostly be doing away with combat altogether and focusing on the story. But honestly, the story isn't that engaging either. Я с самого начала выбрал уровень сложности воин (где-то посередине по шкале сложности, решил не рисковать) и на втором уровне понял, что с меня хватит и уменьшил на один уровень до “Солдата”. Солдат оказался в самый раз. Было сложно, но терпимо и без задротства. А так как игра реально длинная и немного нудная - еще не хватало убиваться об каждого рядового врага. Вполне достаточно было испытывать сложности с боссами.

Особенность геймплея состоит в том, что игра требует наличия определенной группы - танк, целитель и пара дамагеров. У меня был воин - танк, жрец - целитель, и арканист и лучник - дамагеры. В игре враги сосредотачивают свое внимание на том персонаже, который излучает наибольшую угрозу и задача заставлять их атаковать танка, чтобы другие оставались целыми (так как все остальные умирают довольно быстро). Попутно используются разные умения (их не очень много, но выбор есть) и активная пауза (без нее не жить). В этой игре с раскачкой лучше не экспериментировать. Если вам кажется, что выбор очевиден - делайте именно его, иначе не уверен, что вы выиграете даже на легкой сложности. 

Помимо оригинальной боевой системы в игре есть все за что мы любим дискретные приключения - подземелья (хотя это, конечно, скучнее чем открытый мир как во втором гримроке), головоломки и секреты (их не очень много, но они есть). Плюс куча лута и разнообразные враги.

Игра длинная, предупреждаю сразу, подземелья некоторые очень утомительные. Но в целом, удовольствие определенное я получил. Для любителей подобных игр - рекомендую. Финальный босс - форменное издевательство, правда, но тоже можно осилить. 

Все остальное помимо геймплея тут второстепенно. Графика средняя, обычная. Музыка стандартная однообразная. Сюжет с небольшим твистом, но при этом номинальный. Концовка неплохая, но без изысков. Атмосфера игровая. Сложно погрузиться в атмосферу игры, выбирая на старте “танка” и “дамагера”, знаете ли.

"The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition" oyuncuları tehlike, gizem ve sırlarla dolu devasa bir zindanda büyüleyici bir yolculuğa çıkarıyor. Birinci şahıs görünümünde oynanan bu taktiksel savaş ve zindan tarayıcısı karışımı, Dungeon Master™ ve Might & Magic® gibi klasiklerden ilham alıyor ancak üçlü "tank/hasar veren/şifacı" mekanizması ve aktif duraklama sistemiyle modern bir dokunuş getiriyor.

**Hikaye:**
Hikaye, derin bir zindan hapishanesinde yeni işe başlayan bir gardiyan olmanızla başlar. Mahkumların bir gecede kaçmasıyla kaos başlar ve müdürün hızlı bir şekilde tahliye etmesini ister. Kaçan mahkûmları takip etmekle görevlendirilen siz, bir ekip oluşturarak gizemli zindanda maceraya atılıyorsunuz.

**Macera Çağrısı:**
Oyun, oyuncuları düşman orduları ve güçlü yaratıklarla karşılaşarak geniş bir zindanı keşfetmeye davet ediyor. Yolculuk, karmaşık koridorlarda, yeraltı saraylarında, unutulmuş madenlerde ve kötülükle dolu mahzenlerde gezinmeyi içeriyor. Yol boyunca oyuncular bulmacaları çözer, tuzaklardan kaçınır, gizli geçitleri ortaya çıkarır ve labirentlerde ve koridorlarda gezinir.

Karakter Oluşturma:
Oyuncular, her biri macera boyunca gelişen bir dizi büyü ve yetenekle donatılmış dört muhafızdan oluşan bir grubun komutasını alırlar. Muhafızlar seviye atladıkça, yetenek ağaçlarına yatırım yapmak için puan kazanırlar, bu da mevcut yeteneklerin güçlendirilmesine veya yeni güçlerin kazanılmasına izin verir. Dört sınıf (savaşçı, şifacı, büyücü, haydut) ve sınıf başına üç uzmanlık ile çeşitli oyun tarzları sunan 12 temel yapı vardır.

Geliştirilmiş Savaş Sistemi:
Savaş, tehdit yönetimine vurgu yapan "tank/hasar veren/şifacı" mekanizması etrafında dönüyor. Şifacının büyüleri doğrudan düşmanları çeker ve tankın şifacıyı korumak için müdahalesini gerektirir. Savaş sistemi, güçlü düşmanların üstesinden gelmek için yeteneklerin stratejik kullanımını ve etkili kombinasyonları teşvik eder. Aktif duraklatma özelliği, oyuncuların strateji oluşturmasına ve eylemleri sıraya koymasına olanak tanıyarak savaşın hızı üzerinde kontrol sağlar.

Yerleşik Harita Editörü ve Modlama:
Oyun, oyuncuların kendi zindanlarını oluşturmalarını sağlayan sağlam bir harita editörü ile birlikte gelir. Modlama SDK'sı düşmanlar, sınıflar, uzmanlıklar, yetenekler, teçhizatlar ve efsunlar dahil olmak üzere çeşitli oyun öğelerinin ince ayarlarının yapılmasına olanak tanır. Bu zengin özellikli modlama desteği, oyuncuların oyun deneyimini özelleştirmelerini ve genişletmelerini sağlar.

Oyun Özellikleri:

4 karakterli parti
Çeyrek dönüşlerle ızgara tabanlı hareket
Birinci şahıs görüşü
4 sınıf, 12 uzmanlık
5 oynanabilir ırk: insan, cüce, elf, kara elf, buçukluk
Aktif duraklatma ve isteğe bağlı otomatik duraklatmalar
25-50 saatlik oyun süresi
Farklı stratejilere sahip 20 benzersiz boss
100 çeşit yaratık, varyasyonlar dahil
Taktik savaş

I played this game until lvl 15 on Soldier difficulty, around 10 more levels than I should have. In short, this was a game that sparked my dungeon-crawler nostalgia and curiosity alike with it's graphics, design, sound and combat mechanics. However, it failed to kindle any of it after a few levels of repetitive combat, lacklustre exploration and puzzles, frustrating level design and non-gameplay enhancing gear.

The biggest issue with the game for me was that most features balanced between 2 unsatisfactory states with a near impossibility of reaching a satisfactory middle.
Combat: Too much of it and too inconsistent. There is an option in the menu to reduce mod density but this leaves the levels barren, long and mostly boring which segways well into:
Exploration: There is no auto-mapping unless you find maps in the levels (usually at the end of them) or enable the option in the menu where you are told not to because you will no longer "feel lost as you are meant to". But when the corridors are empty and contorted with no end in sight, the last thing you want is to have to figure out where you are. Because even when you have figured out where you are, it usually the end or quite rarely, a puzzle.
Rewards: Puzzles are decent and they feel fun but they are few and far between and reward little more than gear. In addition, given that gear in this game is rarity+stat based without game-impacting features (to my knowledge) it makes a mediocre experience disappointing. I have seen no tome, no interesting consumable, nothing. There was an interesting item somewhere on lvl 2-4 but couldn't figure out how to get to it... wouldn't be surprised if it were story related.

If you don't mind spending the money, this game is a fine to sink up to 5 hours into but I found myself waiting and hoping for more after those first 5 hours without any results in almost 20 more.

9/10 game! Amazing result for the small team that made it happen. Really innovative in a lot of areas. Thank you making this great game. This is such a well-designed game and I can tell you put in a lot of effort and love into it.

* How I learned about the game *
I really loved Legend of Grimrock 1 and 2, and was hungering for more games of that style. I googled and multiple people recommended this game, so I bought it... probably a while back, and it's been sitting in my library. I looked through my backlog a week ago and found this game, and had to give it a spin.

* Things I loved *
1. Each level had some new spin / mechanic to it.
2. The puzzle rooms were unique and different for each level, and they didn't take too long to complete so it wasn't frustrating even when I got stuck.
3. Combat was different and I was looking forward to leveling up.
4. The banters between the party members. I know it's not Baldur's Gate 2 level of banters and it's set, but it really made it feel like the party members were chatting with each other and are real people.
5. The humor! It wasn't too much and was just right.

* Things I wish were different *
1. Didn't love the lighting to the game. It was just so dark at times.
2. Not having the map was fun for a bit, but then at later levels, the map was almost toward the end. I know some players love exploring, but I am one of those that easily gets lost and it was frustrating at times.
3. There was a lot more combat than needed toward the later levels (13+?) (I have the "less combat" turned on).
4. Would have preferred a bit more itemization. It's not the main focus of the game, but unique and sets a la Diablo 2 would be fun (obviously not to that scale). I think having sets in set locations would reward exploration and finding secrets even more.
5. Would have liked more variation on the level tileset.
6. I felt like the game had enough of the story to make me interested while not being too heavy, but it sort of falls flat at the end because nothing is explained. I was expecting the warden to show up at some point, or at least his body. I expected the end of the treasure hunt to be something different but it was just a vampire and he didn't really explain much. The young emperor having two bodies is... I read in another thread you wanted to leave it as a mystery but it just feels like a lost moment. Why did he become this corrupted thing was also never explained. I would have liked a bit more lore and story, especially since we were picking up notes and reading them already. Something like short snippets to piece together the story would have been great, or pieces of lore (what is the Empire? Who are the barbarians?)
7. Would have loved a NG+ to let me keep leveling.
8. The final fight was a bit of a letdown. I leveled all the way to 20 and the game is making me lose levels. It made the fight more challenging, yes, but it felt like the game was punishing me and taking my toys away. If this had happened for one of the four phases, that would have been unique. Happening to all 4 and having it get worse was quite frustrating.
9. Unique art for epic / legendary gear would make them look even more stand out.
10. It felt a bit dragged on toward the end. The sweet spot for me would have been ended at level 15 or so. It's not that the later levels were boring, but they weren't unique enough and the game had really gone on for a while.
11. Some sort of shop or "token exchange for rewards" by the Dungeon Guardian would be great. It feels like something Halaster Blackcloak would do to Undermountain, so I can see the Dungeon Guardian doing it too.

* Looking forward *
Unfortunately, the game didn't seem to have gotten enough attention and thus sales. The chance of an expansion or 2 seems low. I honestly don't know why because I thought this is a great game. I would have loved a sequel.

In the chance there isn't, is it possible to release mod tools? Might be difficult and time consuming to build something if these weren't planned from the start.

Please let me know how I can know what you're working on next, even if it's not a sequel or a similar genre to this game. I would love to support your future work!

This game has a really unique feel. It has great party management mechanics that really feels like you're controlling a full MMO party. Many of the elite fights and even some of the trash mob groups can be very challenging. The talent trees and abilities feel very much influenced by World of Warcraft, which I enjoy quite a bit because I recognize how to use most of these abilities from my WoW experience.

I have a few criticisms, but I think it's important to know there are "helpers" in the options menu that can really change the flow of the game. I've been playing with mostly default settings, except the highlighting items box is checked.

All of the dungeon's levels look almost exactly the same, which makes it easy to get lost. In the later levels, I'm having a lot of trouble managing aggro. The tank doesn't seem to be able to keep threat up, causing the healer to get too much threat, even from renew ticks. Even though the healer already causes so much threat, the global cooldown doesn't leave much room for emergency tactics to save your tank or anyone else, because chances are you're on cooldown.

All in all, this game really does scratch that MMO itch. If you want to play a single player MMO, this and Final Fantasy XII are as close as it gets in my experience.

Поначалу игра казалась мне весьма достойным данжн кроулером с упором на бои, но чем дольше я играл, тем больше негатива во мне скапливалось. Спустя 30 часов я могу охарактеризовать игру лишь как унылую однообразную душниловку. 

Прокачка тут практически безвариативная. Опыта на каждом этаже ровно столько, чтоб отряд после зачистки получил левелап. Без вариантов. Все статы на левелапах растут линейно, самому влиять на их развитие нельзя. Скилы унылые: +3%/+6% к какой-нибудь характеристике, 2% шанса добавить какой-нибудь эффект при атаке и проч. Статистически, оно, конечно, влияет на результат, но ощущения развития при получении нового уровня нет совершенно. Такое ощущение, игра геймдизайнилась в экселе.
Уровень экипировки тоже привязан к этажу подземелья. По сути дропаются тут вещи из одного пула, просто с каждым этажом они становятся сильнее на несколько процентов.
В добавок к этому с каждым новым этажом уровень врагов так же увеличивается на единичку. В итоге получается абсурдная ситуация, что развитие тут полностью бессмысленное. Убери опыт и прокачку - ничего не изменится.

Бои на первых уровнях играются нормально, но потом превращаются в унылое ковыряние толстожопых мобов зубочисткой. Причём сбалансирована игра очень плохо, сложность игры скачет как безумная. То ты непринуждённо зачищаешь уровень, то вдруг встречаешь врага, который одной тычкой убивает половину отряда, а вторую половину оставляет в предсмертном состоянии. Крайне сильно сложность зависит от состава отряда - хоть немного отклонишься от дефолтного отряда, и игра скорее всего станет непроходимой. Разраб попытался заткнуть дыры в балансе, позволив настраивать уровень сложности вручную и снижать ХП и урон мобов чуть ли не до нуля, но, блин, скажем честно, выглядит это отстойно.

Из-за всего вышеперечисленного игра надоедает очень быстро. Я хоть и знатный го​вно​ед, но задушнился уже на 10 этаже подземелья (а всего их 20), снизил сложность и пробежал ещё пять, но на этом мои полномочия всё. Сейчас я считаю, что смотреть в стену - более увлекательное занятие, чем пытаться пройти ещё хотя бы один уровень здешнего данжона. 

Итог: лучше уж в десятый раз пройти Гримрок или Визардри.

我喜欢DRPG游戏，这个是我感觉最“DRPG”的游戏。游戏中的各种设计都是奔着优化DRPG体验而做的。各种交互的细节创新，让我感觉是一种【游戏交互的高自由度】思想。
操作上，此类游戏在第一人称和格子探索上有着不可替代的魅力，然而操作方式的不适应也一直为圈外玩家所诟病。FODG则是提供了多种方式的选择。在界面上有移动箭头的UI，按住鼠标右键可以自由查看视角，可以设置移动就恢复视角，这些设计在你体验完后就能感到：玩过的同类游戏中所体验不到的舒适。
游戏设置中有一个游戏助手，里面提供了许多选项来根据你的喜好自定义各种游戏交互，例如仇恨转移到非坦克队员时自动暂停，这简直不能太贴心了。还有很多选项就不一一罗列了。玩家还可以设置UI界面的大小，可以感受到这个游戏让你对游戏交互有极大的把控感。
接下来就是重点了，游戏的战斗模式，其基础是传统的第一人称回合制战斗。游戏中又加入了很多恰到好处的创新。例如：※实时战斗日志数据曲线图（队伍中输出量、治疗以及仇恨的曲线图，对队员的战斗情况了然于胸）、一键喝药、四圆功能（强大的队员选择系统）、※序列指令（加上了宏指令的优化后将策略进行到底）、战斗职责的系统化（坦克、输出、治疗不再是玩家层面的概念，它融入了游戏交互。这也让敌人在攻击非坦克队员时，系统能给出反应）。
序列指令是战斗的精髓。玩家根据技能的冷却和6秒公共冷却来搭配一个3到4技能槽的序列指令。再加上宏，可以在各种情况连接不同的序列。操作上简单直接，但搭配自由度却非常高，极大提升了游戏的可玩性。
除了【游戏交互的高自由度】这种贴心设计，在引导上制作者也是处处奔着玩家体验，例如游戏地图的开放，你可以选择自己先探索地牢，获得地图后查看地图完成后面的探索；也可以在游戏助手中提前获得地图。还有在遭遇boss前，会有对boss特点和技能的解说，给你挑战Tips，当然你也可以选择跳过来自己摸索。让玩家充分体验战斗的多样性，不枯燥而又有“安全感”。
FODG还开放了编辑器，玩家可以自己制作MOD，现在已经有很多大佬制作了不同主题的MOD。在游戏本身极为强大稳固的框架上，每个MOD都能发挥出其魅力。希望能有汉化版本。
总而言之，FODG，【游戏交互的高自由度】，让你耳目一新，这绝对是你玩过的最“DRPG”的杰作。

Уровней  для  изучения  –  два  десятка,  боссов  со  своими  особенностями  и  навыками  не  меньше.  Кстати,  покидая  уровень  и  отправляясь  дальше,  вы  не  закрываете  себе  дорогу  назад,  в  игре  активно  используются  манёвры  с  возвращением  на  уже  посещённые  этажи.
 
Возможность  создать  свою  партию  из  четырёх  существ,  разумеется,  присутствует.  У  каждого  из  четырёх  базовых  архетипов:  воин,  разбойник,  маг,  целитель  –  присутствует  по  три  подкласса,  так  целитель  может  быть  жрецом,  друидом  или  некромантом,  а  разбойник  ассассином,  дуэлянтом  или  лучником.  Разумеется,  какие-то  классы  лучше  работают  в  связках  с  другими,  но  идеальное  сочетание  –  танк,  лекарь  и  два  наносящих  урон  персонажа  работает  как  всегда.  Боевая  система  это  не  только  четыре  героя,  но  и  возможность  использовать  активную  паузу.  На  высоких  уровнях  сложности  данная  функция  становится  практически  необходимой.  Излюбленная  тактика  исследователей  подземелий  –  потанцевать  вокруг  врагов  –  в  данной  игре  работает  не  всегда,  ибо  противники  перемещаются  за  вами  стремительно  и  “замаха”  не  прерывают,  но  увернуться  от  некоторых  атак  всё  же  можно  и  даже  нужно.

Спустя  семь  с  лишним  лет  после  выхода  (а  играл  я  в  Июне  2023-го)  графически  игра,  конечно,  выглядит  изрядно  устаревшей,  но  кого  это  интересует,  если  сама  игра  интересная?  К  недостаткам  отнесу  то,  что  некоторые  этажи  и  закутки  настолько  тёмные,  что  Гамму  невольно  выкручиваешь  на  1,20  и  не  сбавляешь.

Резюме:  отличная  игра  в  своём  жанре.

Game is good, but very slow and tedious on default settings. It took me some time and several balance tweaks to really start enjoying it.

This game is surprisingly customizable and allow you much more freedom than you expect. If you like me mostly play high speed action games and feel that combat here is a boring micro-heavy slogfest you can easily tweak it into much faster semi-automated version where you would use pause and micro only on elites and bosses. How to do it:
1. Use Low Enemy Density
2. Enable macro in interface options and use them A LOT
3. Raise action queue to 4
4. Enable Custom Game Speed in helpers and switch it to Ludicrous Speed when you fight trash enemies
5. Not necessary, but i also used custom difficulty and lowered enemies hp by 25% and raised damage by 33% relative to difficulty
With all these changes i run around like madman and everyone basically explodes, including my backline, i love it!

I also want to thank dev for personally answering my original negative review and suggesting me some of these changes, wich really helped a lot!

If you are a fan of blobbers/old school dungeon crawlers like Might and Magic or Legend of Grimrock, this is an easy recommendation!

At first I thought it was a cheap knockoff of the Eye of the Beholder and Grimrock games.  Upon getting further into it, I found it to be very enjoyable with more than enough to differentiate it from the games mentioned above.  The developers certainly put a lot of work into it.

Wizardryやダンジョンマスター、D&D Pool of Radianceをやっているようなプレイ感。
リソース管理と戦術の立て方が肝ですが、装備品は申し訳程度な状態からスタートするため、より良いドロップ品を求めて戦闘にも熱が入ります。難易度設定にもよりますが、自信のない方は素直に難易度を落としたほうがいいでしょう。私は難易度低で始めましたが大分ヌルいです。
モンスターはプランドのため、ハック＆スラッシュというわけにはいきませんが、ボスクラスからは比較的良い品が落ちるようです。
ダンジョンのギミックを解いていくのは今の時代だとちょっと面倒臭いのですが、かつてWizardryなどをプレイした人なら楽しめるでしょう。

不満点としては、4人パーティなので本来後列に入れるべき弓系/罠解除クラスが前列になってしまうこと。やはりダンジョン探索は6人パーティがベストと再認識しました。
最も、このゲームでは開錠には鍵がマストなのでシーフ/忍者は必須ではないのですが。とあるフロアで鍵が暗闇に落ちていることがあったので、盗賊系クラスは鍵がなくても開錠できる能力があったほうが良かったかもです。後はモンスターがランダム沸きしてくれたほうがハクスラとしても楽しめたと思います。
ダンジョンギミックは、基本的にノーヒントなので、歩き回る以外に解決方法がありません。難しい箇所には、壁の落書きなどのヒントがあったほうが親切かなと思います。

Guter, alter Dungeon Crawler mit leichter Zugänglichkeit. Keine Experimente, dafür umso wohligeres Retrofeeling.

In vielerlei Hinsicht erinnert THE FALL OF THE DUNGEON GUARDIANS an Genreklassiker wie Might&Magic oder Dungeon Master oder Legend of Ferghail, The Bards Tale, Das schwarze Auge, usw (leider ohne eine Außenwelt - soweit ich das bisher sehen konnte)

Natürlich denkt man auch an neuere Vertreter wie Legend of Grimrock oder 7 Mages, Vaporum, Dungeons of Dragon Knight, Etrian Odyssey, The Keep etc.

Was mir an diesem Titel gut gefällt, ist der immer wieder kurz aufblitzende Humor
(ohne zu albern zu werden, so rekrutiert uns gleich zu Beginn der Kommandant mit den Worten: "Der Dungeon ist gefährlich, rekrutiere noch ein paar andere freiwillige Trottel, äh, Helden...")
und die tutoriale Handhabung der ersten Level.

So wird dieses klassische Spielprinzip auch Neulingen gut beigebracht (die ja dann vielleicht so ihre Liebe zu diesem Genre entdecken)

Dieses Game ist kein Hardcorevertreter des Genres, aber taff genug um auch Veteranen zu fesseln. Die Rätsel und üblichen Bodenplatten, Fallgitter, Speerfallen, etc. sind ebenso vorhanden wie versteckte Auslöser für Geheimtüren, durchschreitbare Wände, epischer Loot und vieles mehr.
Aber auch Komfortfunktionen wie eigene Marker auf der (AUTO-)Map oder gut funktionierende Equip-vergleichs-Infotafeln sind integriert.

Die Grafik ist solide gut mit netten Effekten, das RPG System robust und (vor allem gegen Ende) tiefschürfender als gedacht.

Bisher konnte das Spiel in meinem Herzen den beiden (aus meiner Sicht) besten neueren Vertretern der Gridbased RPGs (Might&Magic X Legacy und Bards Tale 4) nicht das Wasser reichen - aber es bietet genug Unterhaltung und Reiz um es durchspielen zu wollen.

Für Fans ein Muss, für Genreneulinge einen Blick wert :-)

Great indie blobber in the Eye of the Beholder mold, with a WoW-ish class & talent system.  Fully customizable difficulty sliders allow you to fight at whatever level of tension you prefer, from trash mobs who hit like a truck, to bosses with only 1% of their natural HP (all while still qualifying for achievements).  For those who don't like flying blind / missing secrets, there's also a great file in the Guides section with detailed maps of the entire dungeon.  It *is* a long game - this can be considered good or bad depending on your taste.  For rpg-blobbers, I rate it 9 / 10.

Игра ненапряжная из-за разнообразного выбора уровней сложности. И из-за крайне малого количества игр в данном жанре, в эту игру хочется играть.
Игре очень сильно не хватает рандомной генерации подземелий, что дало бы реиграбельность другими партиями.

Из положительного в игре Я отмечу:
Отсутствует так называемый "square-dancing". Когда вовремя стрейфа не получаешь урон в бою.
Хорошее звуковое сопровождение,
Присутствует баланс в талантах,

На мой взгляд в игре есть ряд проблем, которые уничтожают глубину и интерес к игре.

- В бою отсутствует тактика. Бой представляет из себя сумбурное использование скилов по откату.(увеличении сложности игры немного исправляет эту ситуацию)
- Глупое равномерное распределение опыта между партийцами. Не понятно, как танк прокачивается быстрее, чем маг-дамагер, который постоянно добивает монстров.
- Павшие бойцы в бою получают полный опыт, и воскресают самостоятельно (без алтарей, без предметов, без какой-либо помощи).
- При повышении уровня не возможно распределить характеристики персонажей, характеристики повышаются автоматически.
- Сами характеристики персонажей дают мизерные прибавки усиления.
- Тупая система с держанием агра на танке с последующим его лечением.
- Регенерация ХП/МП в не боя, из-за этого пропадает надобность в расходниках и скилах на восстановление.
- Танк одетый в латы может уворачиваться от атак.
- Эпические вещи не такие эпические, одно название. В основном из-за мизерных бонусов которые дают сами характеристики.

Играть в данную игру можно, посоветовал бы Я её, да.

Overall not a bad game, I would put at Neutral. After assessment of other games I gave a Yes to, such as MMX and Bards Tale, I can move this game to a Neutral Yes. Game isn't for me but other people might like the boss fights. Made for real time but has some semblance of turned based.

The game does most all other aspects well: plays smooth and looks decent. Some ideas might seem standard but that can be a major plus in my eyes. 

Then, comes the combat. It just doesn't work for me. My assessment is from a person who prefers true turned based combat and non-mmo global timers. I did appreciate the ability to pause but targeting is cumbersome as are some elite and boss fights. Some are cake walks others I gave up. Got some advice. Pushed forward. Got to another boss, nah not for me. I would've liked a few basic attacks and block skills. Other players might enjoy the sense of urgency, games slightly more like Grimrock. Now roaming around the dungeon and most other portions are fun to explore.

It's pretty good for what it is, a dungeon crawling blobber a la [i]Dungeon Master[/i] and [i]Legend of Grimrock[/i] with the twist of having a real-time with pause that can make things a little less hectic. It won't win awards but it will while the afternoon and then some, impressive considering the company's catalog is almost all tennis games.

I don't often write reviews for games, but I believe The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians merits one. As a modern dungeon crawler, it is outstanding in its class. Though I have not yet completed it, having spent 20 hours playing it, I am eager to discover its conclusion. The dev has put a great deal of effort into balancing the gameplay, making both party composition and talent trees intriguing to experiment with. The game also provides an excellent level of challenge, while still offering a variety of QoL features to satisfy everyone. Overall, you can feel that this game is a true labor of love and the developer's Post-Mortem about his work was pretty interesting to read.
